summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests sigvotatug vedotin (SGN-B6A) alone and with pembrolizumab, with or without carboplatin or cisplatin, in advanced solid tumors such as lung, head and neck, HER2-negative breast, esophageal, gastric, bladder, cervical, ovarian, pancreatic and skin squamous cell cancers. All study drugs are given into a vein (IV); pembrolizumab is given every 3 weeks or every 6 weeks, cisplatin 75 mg/m2 and carboplatin AUC 5 mg/mL per min every 3 weeks, and how long treatment continues is not stated. The study aims to learn about the side effects of sigvotatug vedotin and whether it works to treat solid tumors, and the main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa sigvotatug vedotin (SGN-B6A) solo y con pembrolizumab, con o sin carboplatino o cisplatino, en tumores sólidos avanzados como cáncer de pulmón, de cabeza y cuello, de mama HER2 negativo, de esófago, gástrico, de vejiga, de cuello uterino, de ovario, de páncreas y carcinoma epidermoide de piel. Todos los medicamentos del estudio se administran por vena (IV); el pembrolizumab se administra cada 3 semanas o cada 6 semanas, el cisplatino a 75 mg/m2 y el carboplatino con AUC 5 mg/mL por min cada 3 semanas, y no se indica cuánto tiempo continúa el tratamiento. El estudio busca conocer los efectos secundarios de sigvotatug vedotin y si funciona para tratar tumores sólidos, y no se indica la medida principal de resultado.
who_for: Metastatic or unresectable solid tumor of a listed type, confirmed by biopsy or cytology.
Relapsed or refractory disease, or intolerance to standard therapy (Parts A and B).
Treatment-naive for locally advanced or metastatic systemic therapy (Parts C and D).
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 and a tumor site accessible for biopsy.
not_for: Previous treatment with an MMAE-containing agent or an agent targeting integrin beta-6.
Known active brain metastases, with some exceptions for treated or small asymptomatic lesions.
Another malignancy within 3 years before first dose, or residual disease from one.
Pre-existing neuropathy above the stated grade limit, or noninfectious lung disease needing steroids or current lung disease.
